data.location: 65 King St W, Dundas, ON L9H 1T5, Canada
data.short_description: Râz, a new Persian restaurant from Bohemian Beirut owner Maro Al Chamaa, is preparing to open at 65 King Street West in downtown Dundas. It will move into the former Pinbones space, which relocated to 44 King Street West.

data.location: 20460 FM 1485 Suite A, New Caney, TX 77357
data.short_description: Tacos La Bala, a family-owned Mexican chain, is set to open a new 2,482 sq-ft location in the Caney Crossing shopping center in New Caney. Construction is expected to begin in September 2026 and wrap up at the end of January 2027, with an estimated $250,000 project cost.

Blue Zebra Lounge is planned for the former Copper & Sage space at Uptown Plaza in Phoenix, with a liquor license application filed by owner Allen Shumway. The floor plan includes an indoor dining area, two bars, and patio seating; no opening date has been announced.
Copper & Sage, a Southern-inspired restaurant at Uptown Plaza, closed in 2025 without publicly sharing a reason. The space is now planned for Blue Zebra Lounge.

James Beard Award-winning chef Damarr Brown and Erick Williams of Virtue Restaurant & Bar are preparing to reveal a new unnamed concept in Fulton Market. It will be Virtue Hospitality's sixth concept, with no opening date revealed.

data.status: plans to open / currently under construction
data.short_description: Ob Uan, a Thai restaurant co-owned by Jason Kim, will debut at 1479 First Ave. in the former Spice space on the Upper East Side. The interior will feature pink pastels, buttery yellows, and antique accents, with a menu of Thai classics and regional homemade recipes.

Blendology, a coffee-and-cocktail concept from husband-and-wife team Michell Reyes and Rene Ramos, is targeting a September opening in downtown Greensboro. The 1,500-square-foot space represents an approximate $200,000 investment and will feature specialty coffee from Reyes' family farm in Honduras.

Rosati's Pizza is opening its first central Michigan location in Delta Township, marking the second Michigan restaurant for franchisee Chintan Patel. The Chicago-style pizza chain will be located in the same plaza as Anna's House Grand Ledge, next to a Wing Snob.

data.location: 901 Haddonfield Rd., Cherry Hill Township, NJ 08002
data.short_description: Fogo de Chão plans to open a Brazilian steakhouse in the former Brio Italian Grille space at Towne Place at Garden State Park in Cherry Hill. It will be the chain's fifth New Jersey location and feature the brand's newly developed design with a 360-degree view of the open churrasco grill.

data.location: 3801 Clear Creek Drive, Wheat Ridge, CO 80401
data.short_description: Prost Brewing is opening its fifth Colorado biergarten in Wheat Ridge on August 3, 2026, within the Clear Creek Crossing mixed-use development. The 6,800-square-foot facility will feature 40 taps, a full-service kitchen with traditional German dishes, and a 1-barrel research and development brewhouse.

Chick-fil-A is opening its first Azle, Texas location on July 30, 2026, locally owned and operated by Mike Tipton. The restaurant will offer dine-in, drive-thru, carry-out, third-party delivery, and Mobile Thru services, with a Moove-In Party celebration on opening day.

Pinchy's Lobster & Raw Bar is planned for 508 High Street in downtown Maryville, becoming the New England-inspired seafood concept's third location. The venue will feature over 200 indoor and outdoor seats and an 8,000-square-foot outdoor gathering space adjacent to sister concept The Walnut Kitchen.

Bamboo Sushi is preparing to open its second Washington location in Kirkland, joining its University Village restaurant in Seattle. The Portland-based, SoHi Brands-owned company is recognized as the world's first certified sustainable sushi restaurant.

Fratelli's, a downtown Grand Rapids pizza spot, is opening a second location at 123 W Main Street in Lowell. Owner Maria Cannizzo said the team plans to serve many of the same favorite pizzas, pasta dishes, and breads, and hopes to open by the end of August.

data.location: 4555 S Fort Apache Rd, Ste 144, Las Vegas, NV 89147
data.short_description: Island Deli and Smoothie Bar is expanding with a second location in the Montage Shopping Center in Spring Valley, Las Vegas. The family-owned business specializes in savory sandwiches, unique smoothies, sliders, salads, smoothie bowls, and desserts.

The Old Jailhouse Kitchen & Spirits, based in Sanford, is opening a bar at Orlando International Airport this fall. Owner Alex Sirica said the MCO menu will be abbreviated due to limited kitchen space, but signature cocktails will be featured; the location is operated in partnership with the Marshall Retail Group.

Zaza Cuban Comfort Food announced plans to open its first Osceola County location at The Loop shopping center in Kissimmee, with a launch expected in early 2027. It will be the Central Florida-based chain's eleventh area location.

data.location: 2821 W 11th St, Suite A, Houston, TX 77008
data.short_description: Workaround Cafe, a new co-working coffee shop concept from Jack Heng, is planned for the Greater Heights area of Houston. Construction on the estimated $450,000, 3,001-square-foot project is planned to start December 1 and wrap up by end of January 2027.

LA Urban Fitness is returning to the community with a new Venice location at 235 Main St., formerly Umami Burger. Owner George Salem, who ran the previous Santa Monica location, will bring back the nutrition center and cafe offering organic juice, smoothies, health bars, vitamins, and supplements.

EZPZ Pizza & Soft Serve, which opened in El Segundo this summer, is planning a second location in Studio City in a former Starbucks space. The concept, from Beau Flynn, Marley Shelton Flynn, and chef Scott Tremonti, focuses on New York-style pizza with an emphasis on the crust.

data.location: 940 Chatham Center Drive, Suite 102, Savannah, GA 31405
data.short_description: The Taco Stache, a modern Mexican restaurant and sports bar based in Pooler, GA, is planning a Savannah expansion. Plans have gone before the City of Savannah for liquor licensing at the new outpost.

Springbone Kitchen will join The Market Hall at Manhattan West, a 34,000-square-foot hall featuring 12 casual dining concepts. The health-focused eatery specializes in bowls, broths and soups. An official opening date has not yet been announced.

Boloco's final Boston location will close on September 25, 2026, ending the chain's nearly three-decade presence in the region. The building has been sold and is being converted into residential space. Before closing, the restaurant plans to offer returning menu favorites, free burritos, and additional promotions.

Local Thai brand Sticky Rice announced a new location in development at 523 Rose Ave in Venice. The Venice location will mark the fifth for the brand. Menu items include sticky wings, Thai noodle dishes, curries, chicken satay, and crying tiger.

data.store_name: Italian-inspired market and wine bar (unnamed, by Chef Mark Bolchoz)
data.short_description: Chef Mark Bolchoz of Cane Pazzo is planning an "Italian-inspired market and wine bar" at Blackwells Corner in Hanahan. The chef declined to comment further on the project. Blackwells Corner is a Hanahan town center named after the hardware store that operated on the site for over 75 years.

Plan review documents were submitted by KACEM Inc. for a new restaurant called Wardos Smokin Tacos & BBQ in the former Tijuana Flats space. The owners of Pork Belly's, Eddie and Kate Meek, appear to be branching out with the new barbecue brand. Eddie Meek was not immediately available for comment.

Zig Zag Oyster Bar opened on July 28 at 5 p.m. in the Prospect Heights neighborhood of Brooklyn. The restaurant focuses on East Coast oysters, raw seafood, classic cocktails, and a wine list. It has approximately 50 indoor seats and a patio area.

Dishin Delish is preparing to launch on West Columbus Drive with healthy Latin and Latin fusion cuisine. The owner Maria confirmed the restaurant is opening in the coming weeks. It's described as a small, healthy Latin-American place with lunch and American fusion dishes.

data.status: preparing to make its grand opening soon
data.short_description: Rise & Grind Cafe is preparing to open inside the Strongsville Recreation Center later this summer. The Australian-inspired café will serve coffee and food using locally roasted coffee beans. Additional details about the menu and an official opening date have not yet been announced.

Prana Kitchens is opening at Upper West Market with a grand opening scheduled for August 1. The brand will operate a market stall at Stall 5 featuring handcrafted Ayurvedic-inspired food products and spice blends. Its catalog includes around two dozen products including Chai Masala and Golden Milk mix.

Tootles and French, a high-end bistro and wine bar in Astoria, announced its closure after just three years of operation. The restaurant will serve its final meal on August 8, with personal circumstances cited as contributing to the decision. It will operate with reduced hours and a limited menu during its final weeks.

data.location: 6502 Bolsa Ave., Suite 104, Huntington Beach, CA 92647
data.short_description: Graze Craze, a charcuterie franchise, has officially opened in Huntington Beach at 6502 Bolsa Ave., Suite 104. The 750-square-foot store is owned and operated by Rob and Renee Smith. It offers handcrafted charcuterie boards, catering services, and grab-and-go options.

maman is opening its third Charlotte location on July 29 in Eastover inside a historic 1920s building. The cafe will serve salads, sandwiches, pastries, and signature Nutty Chocolate Chip Cookies. A ribbon-cutting ceremony is planned at 8 a.m. with freebies for early guests.

Din Tai Fung is opening its fourth Orange County restaurant at Brea Mall. A reservation-only soft opening starts August 7, followed by a grand opening on August 31. The menu features Xiao Long Bao, handmade dumplings, noodles, and steamed buns.

Pamana, the Filipino restaurant run by Ethan and Geri Leung, filed for a liquor license at 5424 NE 30th Ave in Portland's Concordia neighborhood. It is unclear whether this marks a second location or a full relocation from The Hoxton hotel. The Leungs plan to make a bigger announcement in September.

El Mariachi Mexican Grill is set to open at 6808 SE Milwaukie Ave in Portland's Sellwood Moreland neighborhood. Owners Jesus and Mariela Zacarias are aiming to open sometime in mid-August. The menu will center on tacos made with fresh, handmade tortillas, with seating for around 45 inside and 15 outside.

Stickers Asian Cafe, a pan Asian street food spot known for potstickers and satay, closed after more than a decade in the Sellwood Moreland neighborhood. The space is being taken over by El Mariachi Mexican Grill.

data.location: 5501 Fields Parkway, Suite B120, Frisco, TX 75033
data.short_description: SusieCakes will open a new bakery inside Frisco's upcoming Fields West development, targeting 2027. The Frisco bakery will be SusieCakes' sixth Texas location. The bakery is known for its Vanilla Celebration Cake, custom-decorated layer cakes, and scratch-made cupcakes.

Levain Bakery could open at 3120 Palm Way within Domain Northside, with a construction completion date targeted for March 2027. It would mark the brand's first Texas location. The signature menu centers on oversized cookies including Chocolate Chip Walnut and Dark Chocolate Peanut Butter Chip.

Sine Wave Coffee, founded by Anthony Brewer, has moved from Tennessee to Florida and grown into a permanent home in Jacksonville's San Marco neighborhood. It started as a mobile coffee cart business half a decade ago. The concept ties together music and coffee culture with handcrafted espresso drinks.

Le Mil's is preparing to open its first brick-and-mortar café at 1330 Polk Street on August 15, becoming San Francisco's only café dedicated exclusively to Indian specialty coffee. It was founded by Milana Ram and Himanshu Bhaisare. The menu will feature pour-overs, espresso drinks, and South Indian filter coffee.

data.location: 1235 S Josey Lane, Suite 535, Carrollton, TX 75006
data.short_description: El Barrio Bakery & Taqueria could open at 1235 S. Josey Lane, Suite 535, with a construction completion date listed as December 2027. Construction is not expected to begin until December 2026. Tenant Ayman Nafal is also President of El Rancho, a Hispanic grocery chain.

The Posh Bagel is opening a new location in Yuba City at 747 Colusa Avenue, per a "coming soon" listing on the company's website. No opening date has been announced. The chain, founded in 1992, is expanding across the Sacramento region.

Pronto Gelato is opening a second Portland location at 232 NE 28th Avenue, targeting October 1. The shop takes over a space vacated by Staccato Gelato in April and will expand its coffee program with a full cafe.

Renaissance Hotel Ottawa Downtown, a lifestyle hotel from RIMAP Hospitality Services Inc., is preparing to open in downtown Ottawa in 2027. It follows RIMAP's AC Hotel by Marriott Ottawa Downtown (2025) and Moxy Ottawa Downtown (2026).

data.location: Dovercourt Village, near Davenport Road and Ossington Avenue, Toronto
data.status: expected to open in late fall
data.short_description: Acornhouse, a new cocktail bar focused on Canadian ingredients and seasonal dishes, is preparing to open in Toronto's Dovercourt Village. Founded by James Park, Jacob Homoki, and Kana Hayashi, an exact opening date has not been announced.
A new Naansense location is listed at 116 N York Street in downtown Elmhurst, marking owners Hiran and Viral Patel's return to the suburbs. As of now, no opening date has been announced.

data.status: liquor license approved, no opening date has been set
data.short_description: Gompers Distillery has applied for and received approval for a liquor license to open a tasting room at 426 SW Broadway in Portland, taking over the former Hood River Distillers Tasting Outpost. No opening date has been set.

data.location: 10 Dundas St E, Toronto, ON M7A 0B2, Canada (The Tenor)
data.short_description: Edo Japan, a Canadian fast-casual teppanyaki-style restaurant, is preparing to open a new location at The Tenor near Yonge and Dundas in Toronto. Construction began in July with a planned landlord handover in September and December opening.
Kura Sushi is preparing to open a new location in Carlsbad at 5970 Avenida Encinas, moving into the former Toast Gastrobrunch space. No exact opening date has been announced.

data.location: 8150 Elk Grove Blvd, Suite 110, Elk Grove, CA 95758
data.short_description: Shake Shack will open its 53rd California location in Elk Grove on August 5 at 10 a.m. The opening includes a charitable partnership donating $1 per sandwich sold to Elk Grove Food Bank Services.

Il Moro, an upscale Sicilian restaurant operated by Vincenzo Galia, will debut at 1130 First Ave on Manhattan's Upper East Side. The restaurant recently applied for a liquor license per Community Board 8 filings.

data.location: 17713 N. SH 130 Service Road NB, Pflugerville Parkway Retail Center, Building 2, Suite 200, Pflugerville, TX 78660
data.short_description: Hao Hao, a Chinese-Vietnamese fusion restaurant, plans to open a new location at Pflugerville Parkway Retail Center per public filings. Owners Binh Tran and Phoebe Hoang did not respond to inquiries about the timeline.

data.location: 6560 Greatwood Parkway, Suite 100, Sugar Land, TX 77479
data.short_description: Wah Coffee Kitchen will host a grand opening of its third location on August 1, 2026, in Sugar Land's Greatwood community. Guests will receive free drinks during the opening celebration.

data.status: anticipate opening our doors within the next few weeks
data.short_description: Toll Man Joe's is returning to Philadelphia at 12th & Pine in Washington Square West, the former home of Mixto. Original founder Lori Penrose leads the return, with opening anticipated within the next few weeks.

Keepers, a new concept from the team behind Dandelion, opens July 29, 2026, in Manhattan's West Village. The bar offers craft cocktails, tavern-style bar pies, and vintage-inspired design with seating for 40.

River Twice, a Michelin Guide-recommended South Philadelphia restaurant, will nearly double its footprint this fall by taking over the former Mantawny Still Works space next door. The expansion adds a 13-seat bar, additional seating, and a wine display.

Fillmore Trattoria, a family-owned Italian restaurant in Portland's Alphabet District, announced its sudden closure on July 24 after more than 10 years. The team cited unforeseen circumstances "beyond our control" and will assess options for reopening.
CAVA opened a new Mediterranean fast-casual restaurant in Schaumburg on July 27, 2026. The location is expected to employ 25-40 local team members and included a Community Day donation initiative.
CAVA opened its doors to the Bellaire, TX community on July 28. Daily hours are 10:30 a.m. to 10 p.m., and the opening event raised funds for Houston Food Bank.

data.status: will serve its final meal on July 31, 2026
data.short_description: Traveler's Cart, a global street market-inspired restaurant and cocktail bar in Montrose, will close on July 31, 2026, after two years. Its flagship sister location, Traveler's Table, will continue operating.

data.location: 1919 Vista Del Lago Dr Suite 5, Valley Springs, CA 95252
data.short_description: Article describes an ownership transfer of the Valley Springs Pizza Factory to R and H Family Legacy LLC in July; the restaurant continues normal operations at the same address. No opening, closing, or remodel event is reported.

data.location: The Juniper, corner of Juniper Street and 11th Street, Midtown, Atlanta, GA
data.status: planned to bring to Midtown in January
data.short_description: A local couple, Freddy Adkins and Mikkel Jensen, are planning to bring Copenhagen cafe culture to Midtown Atlanta with The Danish ATL. They currently have a letter of intent at The Juniper and are seeking additional investors. The menu will feature Danish pastries, coffee, open-face sandwiches, and fresh bread.

La Valle Gelateria, a family-run Italian gelato shop, is preparing to open at 26 King Street West in Dundas in the former Cumbrae's space. A soft opening is planned for August 19 and 20, 2026. The menu will feature handmade gelato, panini, espresso, and pastries.

data.location: 1529 Colusa Highway, Suite 5, Yuba City, CA 95993
data.short_description: Cheemas Havelli Inc has filed for a new on-sale liquor license at 1529 Colusa Highway, Suite 5 in Yuba City, with the filing led by Ramandeep Singh Cheema. The name suggests a Punjabi/North Indian direction. The location was previously home to Taste of India Bombay Lounge.

data.location: 1529 Colusa Highway, Suite 5, Yuba City, CA 95993
data.short_description: The former Taste of India Bombay Lounge closed at 1529 Colusa Highway in Yuba City, the same address where Cheemas Havelli has now filed for a liquor license. Whether the new concept is connected to the former business is not yet confirmed.

data.location: Epicurean Atlanta, 1117 W Peachtree St NW, Atlanta, GA 30309
data.short_description: ENZO Italian Steakhouse & Bar will open its second location inside Epicurean Atlanta this winter, taking over the 2,886-square-foot space formerly home to Reverence. The restaurant offers a North Italian-inspired menu with pastas, protein-driven entrees, and wood-fired steaks. Designer Oliver Carter is partnering to bring the space to life.

data.location: 2324 S. Lamar Blvd., Unit 100, Austin, TX 78704
data.status: planning to reopen; remodel is currently in permitting
data.short_description: Brooms Matcha may be planning to reopen at 2324 S. Lamar Blvd., Unit 100, where a 647-square-foot remodel is in permitting. The brand's social media signals a late-summer opening. Brooms Matcha originally opened in June 2025 and closed in August 2025.

A new Culver's is under construction at 3218 11th Street in Rockford at the former Morris Kennedy School site, from franchisees Jimmy and Nichole Smith. The building still needs to be demolished, with an opening targeted for sometime next year. The new restaurant will have a two-lane drive-thru.

data.location: 2095 Golden Centre Lane, Gold River, CA 95670
data.short_description: World Traveler Coffee Roasters has signed a lease to open at Gold River Town Centre, moving into a space previously occupied by a Starbucks that closed last year. The chain already has multiple locations across the Sacramento region. The menu features in-house roasted coffee, specialty drinks, breakfast sandwiches, and pastries.

data.location: 2095 Golden Centre Lane, Gold River, CA 95670
data.short_description: A Starbucks at 2095 Golden Centre Lane in Gold River Town Centre closed last year as part of a wave of store closures for the chain. World Traveler Coffee Roasters has signed a lease to take over the space.

data.location: 135 E. 63rd St., Upper East Side, New York, NY
data.short_description: Fellini Coffee, owned by Franco Noriega, will debut at 135 E. 63rd St. on the Upper East Side. The 850-square-foot location will feature outdoor seating and serve the brand's signature menu of coffee, cocktails, brunch, and Italian dinner items. The location is currently under construction.

data.location: 25107 Jefferson Avenue, St Clair Shores, MI 48081
data.status: working on expansion; opening will likely be next year
data.short_description: New Order Coffee Roasters will feature a new cafe and larger kitchen at its 25107 Jefferson Avenue shop, along with a walk-up window for ordering. Owner Patrick Seeney is expanding the food menu. Staff told What Now Detroit the opening will likely be next year as the team works with the city on plans.

data.status: set to debut; plans to open after Labor Day
data.short_description: Jean Claude, owned by Kamel Moumeni, is set to debut at 1481 York Ave. on the Upper East Side as its second location. The interior will be completely renovated ahead of opening. The menu features French brasserie-inspired fare including croque monsieur, steak frites, and moules marinières.

data.location: 408 W Sam Ridley Pkwy, Smyrna, TN 37167
data.short_description: Mi Camino Real, an 18-year-old Mexican restaurant in Smyrna, Tennessee, has permanently closed. The closure was announced on social media on July 21. The restaurant did not share an official reason for the closure and thanked the community for 18 years of support.

Chick-fil-A will open a new restaurant, Chick-fil-A Boggy Creek, in Orlando on Thursday, July 30, 2026, locally led by Jon Morris. The restaurant will provide dine-in, drive-thru, carry-out, third-party, and Mobile Thru service. Grand opening promotions include a Moove-In Party and a $25,000 donation to Second Harvest Food Bank of Central Florida.

data.location: Spring Quarter, 1020 Spring St NW Ste 101, Atlanta, GA 30309
data.short_description: Sozou, a new Japanese restaurant led by Chef Fuyuhiko Ito and Chef Lisa Ito, will open at Spring Quarter in Midtown Atlanta on August 7, 2026. The restaurant offers omakase, à la carte, and robata dining. Signature dishes include wagyu toban yaki, black cod miso-yaki, and lobster toban yaki.

The House of William & Merry in Hockessin, operated by chef Bill Hoffman and his wife Merry Catanuto, has permanently closed after 15 years. The closure was announced on July 26, 2026. The owners said the decision was not related to business challenges but to starting a new chapter.

Chef Anne Quatrano has opened Summerland at Upper West Market in Atlanta on July 22. It serves as the anchor restaurant for the new indoor market and offers a farm-inspired menu with seasonal, locally sourced ingredients. It is led by Executive Chef Faye Poon.

The Pub, a 75-year-old South Jersey steakhouse in Pennsauken, will temporarily close beginning August 3, 2026, for a "short vacation." The restaurant plans to reopen Friday, September 18. This is the third consecutive summer break for the restaurant.

data.location: Near the Mall of Georgia, Buford, GA
data.short_description: Portillo's is opening its second Atlanta-area location in Buford, near the Mall of Georgia, where renovations are currently underway. The Chicago-based chain opened its first Atlanta-area location last fall. The opening timeline has not yet been announced.

data.status: will occupy a 350-square-foot space that will undergo renovations
data.short_description: Taqueria Taquito Express is opening its newest location in Little Five Points in a 350-square-foot space that will undergo renovations. The brand currently operates 12 locations across the Greater Atlanta area. The opening timeline is yet to be announced.

data.status: preparing to make its Georgia debut
data.short_description: Sushi by Bou is preparing to make its Georgia debut in Midtown Atlanta. The omakase concept has yet to announce an opening date. The brand currently operates 20 locations.

data.status: signed a lease to open; storefront will be customer-ready in early 2027
data.short_description: South Block has signed a lease to open at 700 Pennsylvania Avenue SE in Eastern Market, with the storefront to be customer-ready in early 2027. The menu features acai bowls, smoothies, toasts, and juices made with organic and fresh ingredients. A grand opening block party is planned with free acai bowls for the first 100 visitors.

data.location: Wedgewood Commons, 5070 Goodman Road, Suite 101, Olive Branch, MS 38654
data.short_description: 3 Guys Pizza Pies has officially begun construction on its new location at Wedgewood Commons in Olive Branch. Ownership said no clear opening timeline is available yet, as they are still waiting on equipment and finishing work. The pizzeria also operates in Southaven and Lakeland.

Connie's Chicken has set its sights on Olive Branch at 8220 Goodman Road for its fourth location, with owners anticipating being customer-ready in early October. The restaurant uses fresh, never-frozen ingredients and a seed-oil-free recipe cooked in 100% beef tallow. Connie's currently has locations in Oxford, Tupelo, and Starkville.

data.status: certificate of occupancy currently under review
data.short_description: Alfresco Flavas Bar N Grill, a 2,600-square-foot restaurant/brew pub with sale of alcoholic beverages, has a certificate of occupancy under review with Memphis and Shelby County as of July 23 for 1299 Madison Avenue. It is registered to James Smith, the restaurateur behind Flava House.

El Metate, a 1,796-square-foot Mexican restaurant with indoor dining, a bar, and an outdoor cafe, has applied for a New Class B Beer, Wine & Liquor License to open at 2302-2304 Price Avenue in Wheaton. The concept has no digital footprint; details come from the liquor license application.

data.status: opening pushed back to summer of 2027
data.short_description: Tiki Thai, a Pattana Restaurant Group concept fusing fine Thai dining with a tiki aesthetic, has delayed its Crystal City opening at 244 19th Court S (ground floor of the Reva apartment building) from autumn to summer 2027 due to permitting hold ups. It will be the brand's second location, joining an existing Reston store.
data.location: 244 19th Court S, Suites #10 and 15, Arlington, VA 22202

data.status: opening at Top of the Sipp in Southaven, Mississippi in 2026
data.short_description: Sips Dirty Soda Shop, run by the Wayne, Amy, and Amelia Perkins family, will open its first DeSoto County location at the Top of the Sipp development in Southaven before the end of 2026, serving dirty sodas, Dirty Alani Energy Drinks, Red Bull Infusions, and Dippin' Dots Floats. The announcement was made on the shop's Facebook page, and the family plans to grow further throughout DeSoto County.
data.location: Top of the Sipp, Southaven, Mississippi
